title: Matrix Characterization of Complete Intersections
statement: Let $P$ be an ideal projector and let $M_j$ be multiplication by $x_j$ on $\mathbb{C}[x_1,\ldots,x_d]/\ker P$. Characterize when $\ker P$ is a complete intersection in terms of the commuting matrices $M_1,\ldots,M_d$.
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Multivariate Splines and Algebraic Geometry (2016), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/21, pp. 1139--1200](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2015/21)
